title: Why AI Harms Can’t Be Fixed One Identity at a Time: What 5300 Incident Reports Reveal About Intersectionality

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating intersectional scores and amplification scores to measure the joint prevalence and disproportionate representation of overlapping identity categories (e.g., adolescent girls, lower-class people of color) causally linked to harm in AI incident reports.
Applying an LLM-based structured rubric to AI incident reports to extract age-related identities and assessing their causal relevance to the harm using counterfactual evaluation.
